provenance.labelled_by: coding agent, by eye: every crop inspected at 2x and compared with its source photograph
provenance.labelling_type: single annotator, no second pass, no inter-annotator agreement
provenance.independence: This set was built AFTER the v1.4 classifier was frozen and was never used to choose any threshold. Order of work: (1) thresholds fixed on labels/traffic_lights/gt.json (the v1.1 dev set), (2) classifier frozen, (3) images fetched, (4) proposals generated, (5) labels written from the crops only.
provenance.crop_tier: verified-proposal: crops are the detector's boxes; presence and state were checked by eye, boxes were not redrawn. Crop labels describe what the crop shows, which is not always the state of the signal in the scene (see 'src_state' and 'crop_missed_lamp').

taxonomy.unlit: signal housing with no lit lamp visible in this crop
taxonomy.other_signal: pedestrian/bicycle signal, reported separately from vehicle heads
taxonomy.not_a_traffic_light: detector box that does not contain a signal
taxonomy.ambiguous: all three lamps appear lit (long exposure); no single correct state

provenance.sources: test_data/tl_v2/sources.json - Wikimedia Commons, each entry with author, licence and page URL
provenance.note: Images are 1600 px renderings; the crops are adaptations of CC BY-SA / CC BY / CC0 works and carry the same licence as their source.
